text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This was a good victory. I have no
complaints.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Empress, my wish is to always
strive for this
standard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Empress, my wish is to always
strive for this
standard.
choice_data_list_en: Don't let your guard down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Calm down. It was a single victory. I still
have
much to achieve.
choice_data_list_en: Don't let your guard down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We need to maintain our focus for the
next race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not saying you can't be pleased.
Just don't
go overboard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm aware of my status as Empress. The
word "lax"
is not in my dictionary.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Even I'm allowed to smile after a
victory.
choice_data_list: いつもより愉快そうだけど
choice_data_list_en: You seem more amused than usual, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Grah! Stop smirking! Stop it now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You warn me about being lax, but you're
the most
laid-back person here!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well—I'll whip you back into shape!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I endure another one of Air Groove's
lectures, but
she seems cheerful even as
she tells me off.
